metadata.description: HumanizerWRT — strip the AI voice out of writing, or never put it there. Five measured layers, ~40 cited studies, and a stdlib stylometry script so it is measurement rather than vibes.

plugins.name: humanizerwrt
plugins.description: Audit text against the five layers where LLM prose measurably diverges from human prose, rewrite an AI draft toward a specific author's voice using samples of their writing, or draft in-register from the start. Ships a zero-dependency stylometry script and an always-on CLAUDE.md block that installs and repairs itself.
